note: Phase 1 methodology extracted from action_log.jsonl: (1) read ground-truth lab documents + QA report first, (2) derive research threads from the concrete gaps found in that ground truth rather than from generic topic lists, (3) run one or more web searches per thread, (4) WebFetch every candidate source before citing and record VERIFIED/PARTIAL/FAILED/CORRECTED with a keep-or-discard decision, (5) retry once via an alternate URL form (abs/html vs pdf) before discarding, (6) correct claims when the fetched content contradicts the search snippet, (7) discard low-quality SEO aggregator sources on source-quality grounds even if they resolve, (8) write one .md per thread with Why-this-thread / Findings / Sources / Discarded, (9) write the JSON recommendation array, (10) validate the JSON and confirm all artifact paths exist.
